---
name: A key doesn't work
about: A button does nothing, or the wrong thing, on your device
title: "<key> doesn't work on <device>"
labels: profile
---

**Device:** manufacturer, model and software version (for example "NVIDIA SHIELD TV Pro, Android TV 11")

**Profile you picked:** (for example "Android TV / Google TV")

**Key:** the remote button or command (for example "Back")

**What happened:** nothing, the wrong action, or it works only sometimes

**Anything else:** a key that does work instead, or how the device's own remote behaves
